---
title: "Spatial Data in R"
format: html
---

## Read the Zarr file

```{r}
library(SpatialData)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(SingleCellExperiment)

spd <- readSpatialData("c26t16_align.zarr/")
spd
```

## Plot data

```{r}
ps <- list(
    p1 <- plotImage(spd, i=2, coord = "aligned"), 
    p2 <- plotShape(spd, fill="grey"))
wrap_plots(ps)
pile(ps)
```


## Exctract features

```{r}
(sce <- mask(image(spd, i="C26T16_GFP"), shape(spd)))
assay(sce)[,1:4]
```


## Check

```{r}
tmp = spd$tables[[1]]
colData(tmp)$gfp <- colSums(assay(sce))
colData(tmp)

as.data.frame(colData(tmp)) |>
    ggplot(aes(-array_row, -array_col, color = log(gfp))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_viridis_c()
```
